name: Altsoba Ragetotem
summary: At Bloodvenom Post, Altsoba Ragetotem equips Horde travelers for the blighted woods of Felwood. The tauren weaponsmith offers maces, staves, and axes.

sections.title: Armorer of Bloodvenom Post
sections.body: Altsoba Ragetotem outfits Horde scouts and travelers bound for Felwood’s corrupted woods from Bloodvenom Post. The outpost stands in the forest’s heart, amid demonic corruption and tainted wildlife. Keeping supplies moving there is a grim necessity. Altsoba offers sturdy crescent axes and heavy war mauls, so warriors entering the corrupted timberlands have weapons at hand.

faq.answer: Altsoba Ragetotem is a tauren vendor at Bloodvenom Post, the Horde encampment in Felwood. He provides basic heavy weapons to travelers and defenders braving the blighted valley.
Altsoba sells standard melee weapons, including battle staves, morning stars, war mauls, and axes. They offer dependable steel to those venturing deep into Felwood.

faq.q: Where can I find Altsoba Ragetotem?
faq.answer: Altsoba Ragetotem can be found at Bloodvenom Post, along the cliffs overlooking Felwood’s foul waters and tainted glades.

angles.text: As a Horde operative, you can rely on Altsoba for martial supplies while holding your ground in one of Kalimdor’s most corrupted regions.
As a tauren, you share Altsoba’s Ragetotem heritage and the steadfastness his people bring to a land suffering under demonic blight.
